    • 字段详细资料

      • algorithm

        @NameInMap(value="Algorithm")
public String algorithm

        The encryption algorithm. Valid values:

        • AES_128_CBC
        • AES_128_GCM
        • AES_128_CTR
        • AES_128_ECB
        • AES_256_CBC
        • AES_256_GCM
        • AES_256_CTR
        • AES_256_ECB
        • SM4_128_CBC
        • SM4_128_GCM
        • SM4_128_CTR
        • SM4_128_ECB
        example:

        AES_256_GCM

      • encryptionKey

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionKey")
public String encryptionKey

        The custom Key Management Service (KMS) master key ID. Note This parameter takes effect only when the column encryption key pattern is set to kms_key. If this parameter is not specified, the current column encryption key settings of the database remain unchanged.

        example:

        749c1df7----

      • encryptionKeyMode

        @NameInMap(value="EncryptionKeyMode")
public String encryptionKeyMode

        The column encryption key mode. Valid values:

        • client_key: configures a user-generated random key on the client side.
        • kms_key: configures a custom key by using Alibaba Cloud KMS.

        Note After an instance is configured to use a KMS key, you can no longer configure a random key on the client side.

        example:

        kms_key

      • requestId

        @NameInMap(value="RequestId")
public String requestId

        The request ID.

        example:

        D0073A98-52F1-3075-8256-3943F*******

      • whiteListMode

        @NameInMap(value="WhiteListMode")
public Boolean whiteListMode

        Specifies whether the whitelist mode is enabled.

        example:

        true
